summary: One sprint since Interview-safe facts and pull request import (milestone 75). The career interview reads as a conversation: interviewer and candidate turns as chat bubbles, the answer shown at once with a writing indicator while the interviewer replies, and the session's topics listed beside the chat with their state (#2338). Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line; a failed send keeps the answer. Skip, I don't remember and Set this topic aside are quick-reply chips, and the summary to confirm is a card after the conversation (#2339). A server with no interviewer model says so instead of offering topics that every click would refuse, and a refused action shows beside its controls (#2337). No paid model run.
knownLimitations: Voice answers still go through the microphone button on the answer box; a dedicated voice mode is the next step. The interview needs DRAFT_LOOP_SCREENING=rules+model and a Claude key on a self-hosted server. The local-first desktop has no career interview.
